The vibrant districts of Southside, The Mailbox and Grand Central offer an excellent selection of independent cafés, restaurants, bars and retail outlets, whilst Birmingham New Street Station provides outstanding transport links across the country. listings.description: Maguire Jackson are delighted to offer this beautifully presented three-bedroom penthouse apartment in the highly sought after Queens College Chambers development situated on the edge of the historic Victoria Square, Birmingham. Having a roof top garden providing views across the Birmingham skyline and exceeding 2200sqdt this provides a rare opportunity to own one of Birmingham’s premium homes.  A Rare Opportunity to Own One of Birmingham's Most Distinguished City Residences  Set within the iconic Queens College Chambers, this exceptional penthouse apartment offers an outstanding blend of timeless heritage, contemporary luxury and unrivalled outdoor space in the very heart of Birmingham.  Accessed via secure street-level entrances or the private underground parking, residents are welcomed into an impressive communal foyer, where a daytime concierge provides both convenience and peace of mind. From here, lift and stair access lead effortlessly to this remarkable residence.  Upon entering, a generous reception hallway immediately establishes the sense of space and refinement that defines the home. Cleverly designed with excellent built-in storage, the hallway provides an elegant introduction to the beautifully appointed accommodation beyond.  The spectacular open-plan living, dining and kitchen area forms the heart of the home. Bathed in natural light from dual-aspect windows, this expansive entertaining space flows seamlessly onto the private rooftop terrace, creating an exceptional indoor-outdoor lifestyle rarely found within the city centre. Whether hosting sophisticated gatherings or enjoying quiet evenings overlooking the skyline, this remarkable setting offers an unforgettable backdrop.  The contemporary kitchen has been thoughtfully designed with an extensive range of fitted cabinetry, complemented by integrated cooking appliances including an electric oven, hob and extractor, together with ample space for additional appliances.  The principal bedroom is an impressive private sanctuary, benefiting from dual-aspect windows, bespoke fitted wardrobes and a luxurious en-suite bathroom complete with a double walk-in shower, elegant bath, wash basin and WC.  A second generous double bedroom also features fitted wardrobes and enjoys direct access to a beautifully appointed Jack-and-Jill bathroom, while the third double bedroom provides equally comfortable accommodation with its own stylish en-suite shower room, creating an ideal arrangement for guests or family members.  Undoubtedly one of the apartment's defining features is the magnificent private rooftop garden. Beautifully landscaped with low-maintenance artificial lawn, this extraordinary outdoor retreat commands breathtaking panoramic views across Birmingham's skyline, encompassing the architectural splendour of Victoria Square and the historic Birmingham Town Hall. A space of exceptional rarity, it provides an enviable setting for al fresco dining, entertaining or simply enjoying the city's ever-changing skyline.  The apartment also benefits from having a daytime concierge, two allocated secure parking spaces and is being sold with no chain.  Queens College Chambers is one of Birmingham's most distinctive Grade II listed developments, where historic architecture has been sympathetically transformed to create an exclusive collection of prestigious residences. Rich in character and architectural detail, the building successfully combines its Victorian heritage with the comforts of modern city living.  Perfectly positioned on Suffolk Street Queensway, the development places the very best of Birmingham on your doorstep. The Bullring & Grand Central, Brindleyplace, the financial district and the vibrant Chinese Quarter are all within easy walking distance, together with an exceptional selection of award-winning restaurants, stylish cafés, boutique shopping and cultural attractions.  Exceptional connectivity further enhances the appeal, with Birmingham New Street, Birmingham Moor Street and Birmingham Snow Hill stations all just moments away, providing direct links across the UK.  Offering a rare combination of architectural heritage, generous proportions, spectacular private outdoor space and an unrivalled city-centre location, this outstanding penthouse represents one of Birmingham's most desirable residential opportunities—a home of genuine distinction that is seldom available and impossible to replicate. listings.description: Offering well-proportioned accommodation throughout, this 1-bedroom flat on Inveresk Street is an excellent opportunity for buyers looking for a comfortable home in a popular and well-connected Glasgow location. The property combines generous living space with a practical layout and convenient access to local amenities and transport links.     Upon entering, you are welcomed by a bright and spacious hallway providing access to the principal rooms.     The lounge is bright and spacious, benefiting from plenty of natural light and creating a comfortable setting for relaxing and everyday living. The separate modern kitchen provides a practical layout with good storage and worktop space, making it well suited to everyday cooking and dining.     The bedroom is generously proportioned and offers ample space for freestanding furniture, providing a comfortable and versatile space that can be tailored to suit your needs.     The accommodation is completed by a family bathroom, featuring a bath and overhead shower.     The location is another key advantage. Inveresk Street is situated within the popular Greenfield area, offering easy access to a wide range of local shops, supermarkets, everyday amenities, and well-regarded schools. Excellent public transport links provide straightforward access to Glasgow City Centre and surrounding areas, making this an ideal location for commuters.     For buyers seeking a home in a convenient and well-connected location, this property offers an excellent combination of comfort, practicality, and location.     Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the space and location this home has to offer.

Step into this stunning two-bedroom upper conversion, situated in a picturesque and leafy corner of Dumbreck. Boasting approximately 1164 sq ft of spacious living, this property features driveway parking, a private front garden, main door entrance, and an enchanting balcony that enhances its charm.  Positioned in a tranquil residential area, this home offers the perfect balance of peaceful living while being conveniently close to local amenities, highly regarded schools, and excellent public transport options. Enter through a side entrance that leads to the bright and inviting main upper hallway. The expansive lounge, highlighted by a large bay window, is bathed in natural light and provides beautiful views of the lush front garden.  The newly refitted dining-sized kitchen, completed in May 2026, features stylish wall and floor units and an integrated gas hob and oven. There's ample space for a dining table and chairs, and the kitchen opens up to a delightful private balcony, an ideal spot for morning coffees or and evening glass of wine after a long day.  This fabulous home includes two spacious double bedrooms that offer comfort and versatility, along with a bathroom equipped with a fresh white three-piece suite and an over-bath shower. With gas central heating and double glazing throughout, it ensures warmth and energy efficiency year-round.  With its combination of driveway parking, well-kept front gardens, spacious accommodation and its excellent condition, this home offers everything you will need.   Dumbreck is a delightful suburb located in the south side of Glasgow, known for its serene ambiance and lush greenery. The area is characterized by its friendly community atmosphere, making it an ideal place for families and individuals seeking a peaceful lifestyle. Residents enjoy a variety of local amenities, including shops, cafes, and parks, all within easy reach. The suburb is also home to excellent schools, providing quality education for children of all ages. With convenient transport links to Glasgow city centre, Dumbreck offers the tranquillity of suburban living while keeping the vibrancy of city life within easy access.  EER band C

This three-bedroom apartment has the kind of character that is becoming increasingly difficult to find, even in the West End. Occupying an elevated ground floor position of a handsome sandstone terrace in Dowanhill, it combines the scale and architectural detail of a traditional Glasgow home with a series of beautifully finished alterations that give it a personality entirely of its own.  The living room is undoubtedly one of the defining spaces. Extending to over six metres in length, a broad bay window brings in an abundance of natural light, while the high ceilings, elaborate cornicing, decorative plasterwork, wall panelling and substantial period fireplace give the room a wonderful sense of occasion. There is plenty of space for separate sitting and dining areas without either feeling compromised.  The contemporary kitchen fits in well to the living space. A substantial stone-topped island provides plenty of preparation and informal dining space, while the clean cabinetry and brass detailing sit comfortably alongside the original architecture. It creates a sociable arrangement, with the kitchen, dining and sitting areas naturally connected.  The principal bedroom is another particularly memorable room. Generous proportions, ornate plasterwork and an original fireplace provide the backdrop, while the addition of a freestanding bath and cleverly incorporated walk-in shower behind the fitted wardrobes gives an individual and luxurious result, without losing the character of the original room.  There are two further bedrooms and a separate bathroom. One of the bedrooms also incorporates a mezzanine level, reached by ladder and currently providing useful additional space that lends itself particularly well to a home office or occasional guest area.  The bathroom has been finished in a contemporary style, with a freestanding bath, marble-effect surfaces, soft green tiling and brass fittings. An attractive stained-glass window is a particularly nice detail and continues the balance between traditional character and modern design found elsewhere in the home. The property also benefits from a separate storage room, which has been cleverly adapted to provide a dedicated laundry area alongside useful additional storage.  Additional benefits include gas central heating and secure entry, together with access to a shared rear garden. Residents also benefit from off-street parking to the rear, with four spaces shared between the six flats and primarily used for visitor parking.  What perhaps sets the property apart is the amount of original detail that remains. The cornicing and ceiling plasterwork are exceptional and the communal entrance makes an impression, with its decorative tiled floor, columns and period fireplace.  Crown Terrace itself is quietly positioned in the heart of Dowanhill, with Byres Road, Hyndland Road, the Botanic Gardens and the University of Glasgow all within easy walking distance, along with the cafés, restaurants and independent shops for which this part of the West End is so well known. Residents benefit from access to the beautifully maintained pleasure gardens, a peaceful retreat from the urban bustle.  Whilst every effort is made by Yates Hellier to ensure the accuracy of these details, it should be noted that measurements are approximate and all information including service charges, ground ownership and school catchment has been provided by the vendor and their accuracy cannot be guaranteed and should be verified through your solicitor and local council.

listings.description: 2/2 Claremont Mansions is a magnificent three bedroom, duplex apartment in this much-admired refurbished development, with lift and underground parking. Occupying a prime corner position, this apartment has superb southerly views over mature trees and the residents' pleasure gardens.  The stylish interior offers flexible accommodation and extends to over 2950 sq.ft. The building is entered into a stunning communal hallway with lift and stair access to all levels and internally, the property is entered into a reception hallway with storage off, formal lounge, and corner sitting room/open plan kitchen/dining area. A useful utility room and WC complete this level on offer.  An internal staircase leads to the upper landing where there are three bedrooms, the principal benefitting from a dressing area and en suite bathroom with separate bath and shower. Bedroom three also benefits from an en suite shower room, and a shower room off the hall services bedroom two. The property also benefits from a superb private terrace accessed from the upper landing, an allocated parking space in the private underground garage with electric door, video entry to the building, double glazing and gas central heating.  EER Band: B   Local Area  Arguably the most sought after and desirable location in Glasgow, is the Park.  The Park District area is bordered by the City Centre, Kelvingrove, Kelvingrove Park and Woodlands. Park Circus was built between 1855 and 1863. Many of the area's large townhouses which were converted to offices during the latter half of the 20th century are being returned to residential use. It was declared a Conservation Area in 1970.  One of the main attributes of the Park area is the accessibility of both the West End's and City Centre's wide range of amenities. Park offers a leafy tranquil surrounding yet is only minutes from access to the M8 at Charing Cross.  There is excellent local and private schooling in the area and an underground station at Kelvinbridge. It is also an ideal location for those looking to study at Glasgow University.

A supremely stylish and thoughtfully designed one bedroom first floor apartment nestled within the vibrant suburb of Totterdown, positioned on the cusp of desirable Perrett Park with fantastic city wide transport links. A superb pied-à-terre with exceptional attention to detail and far reaching skyline vistas, this contemporary BS4 home is located within an attractive period house conversion constructed in approx. 1900.  Having been rewired, replumbed, replastered with new lighting, doors and windows, the property will undoubtedly appeal to an array of buyers. A spacious communal lobby and staircase leads up to Flat 3; a welcoming internal hallway then gives access to all rooms. The inspired open plan kitchen, living room is immaculately presented with high specification cabinetry, comprising two-tone shaker style wall and base units with striking worktops and a desirable fitted island. Benefiting from luxury hardware, integrated appliances, fitted gas hob, inset stainless steel sink as well as a pull out nickel mixer tap, this inviting space is light filled thanks to glazed double doors and Juliette balcony. With elegant herringbone wooden floor, period picture rail and inset ceiling spotlights, the cosy lounge and sociable breakfast bar area are cleverly zoned.  The adjacent double bedroom is tastefully presented with another set of glazed double doors and Juliette balcony. Further benefits include column radiators, a striking colour flooded ceiling, upgraded hardware in addition to ample space for freestanding furniture. The sophisticated, fully tiled neighbouring shower room comprises a contemporary walk-in cubicle with rainfall fitment, alongside a trendy vanity storage unit, fashionable back lit mirror, heated towel rail as well as low level W/C.  Situated in Totterdown, a popular neighbourhood south east of Bristol city centre, renowned for its colourful Victorian and Edwardian terraces, elevated position and views across the city. The area offers excellent access to Bristol Temple Meads, the Harbourside and a plethora of nearby amenities along Wells Road. With a strong community atmosphere, period architecture and green spaces, Totterdown remains a sought-after and well-established residential location.  We are led to believe that there are approx. 975 years remaining on the lease with an annual service charge of £399 as well as £25 ground rent.  ***Although this information is thought to be materially correct its accuracy cannot be guaranteed and does not form part of any contract.***

The Property-  Beautifully finished and bathed in natural light, this stunning top-floor apartment offers an impressive open-plan living space with elegant double-aspect sash windows. Perfect for entertaining or relaxing, the room comfortably accommodates both a lounge and dining area. The sleek, newly fitted kitchen is a real highlight, complete with integrated appliances including a fridge/freezer, dishwasher, and washing machine, along with stylish induction hobs, an electric oven, and a contemporary one-and-a-half bowl sink. Both bedrooms are generous double rooms, each featuring double-aspect sash windows that flood the space with natural light. The bathroom is immaculately presented, finished with stylish partially tiled walls, and fitted with a bath and shower over, heated towel rail, extractor fan, a WC, and a contemporary basin with mixer taps. The entrance hall provides access to all rooms and benefits from a secure intercom entry system.  Outside-  Accessed via an exceptionally attractive communal hallway and a small shared vestibule, the apartment also benefits from an allocated parking space to the rear of the property.  Location-  Clifton is a historic and affluent residential area in Bristol, situated just to the west of the city center. The area is known for its stunning Georgian and Victorian architecture, grand terraces, and elegant squares. Clifton is home to a mix of families, young professionals, and students, and offers a range of amenities such as boutique shops, cafes, restaurants, and bars. The area is also home to several prestigious schools and the University of Bristol, making it a popular choice for academics and students. Clifton is well-connected to the rest of Bristol via public transport, and is home to several iconic landmarks such as the Clifton Suspension Bridge and the Clifton Observatory. With its combination of historic charm, upmarket amenities, and cultural attractions, Clifton is a sought-after location for those looking to live in Bristol.   Council Tax Band: C Tenure: Leasehold (950 years) Service Charge: £200 per month

listings.description: Guide Price: £650,000 - £675,000 - An incredibly rare and beautifully presented, three bedroom garden apartment situated in a magnificent, Grade II* listed, end of terrace building in the heart of Clifton Village. overlooking the highly coveted Victoria Square.  The property has been well maintained and refurbished over the years during the current owner’s tenure and retains a wealth of period features throughout. The building itself was believed to have been the residence of W.G. Grace at the end of the 19th Century and occupies arguably the best position on this desirable garden square.   Measuring in excess of 1200 sq ft, it blends a wonderful mix of traditional charm and contemporary living and provides a superb environment in which to dine and entertain family and friends.  The well-appointed accommodation accessed via its own private entrance briefly comprises a warm and welcoming hallway, impressive formal reception with attractive feature fireplace, separate kitchen / dining room with bespoke fitted kitchen which measures in excess of 30 ft in length and benefits from a useful storage pantry. In addition, there are three bright and airy bedrooms (two doubles / one single), smart family bathroom and stylish en-suite shower / utility room.   Externally, the apartment sits within a generous plot and has a stunning , private landscaped rear garden which is a real asset of the property and is a true hidden gem. Laid primarily to lawn, it has an extensive selection of floral / shrub borders and a delightful, spacious paved patio and is the ideal spot for al fresco dining due to its sunny aspect and remarkable privacy.  Furthermore, there are beautifully manicured communal grounds which are a real delight plus there is convenient bike storage for the sole use of residents.  The apartment is situated in a truly phenomenal position in Clifton Village and is literally a stone’s throw from the myriad of boutique shops, restaurants, cafes, bars and delis that the salubrious Village has to offer. The beautiful green open spaces of the Durdham Downs are also within walking distance, along with Park Street and Whiteladies Road.   Properties of this distinction are very rare to the market so an internal inspection is highly recommended so please call CJ Clifton for more details and to arrange a viewing

listings.description: Stunning duplex penthouse at Vista River Gardens, available to view now.   Description   Crowning one of Manchester's most striking new landmarks, this exceptional duplex penthouse offers a rare opportunity to experience elevated living at its finest.  Set across the 53rd and 54th floors of the striking 55-storey Vista River Gardens — positioned along the tranquil banks of the River Irwell at Trinity Island — this premium two-bedroom, three-bathroom residence spans 1,082 sq ft and delivers breathtaking, far-reaching views across the city and river below.  Designed with both relaxation and entertaining in mind, the penthouse features expansive open-plan living spaces bathed in natural light through floor-to-ceiling windows. The elevated specification runs throughout, including air conditioning, electric roller blinds, and elegant herringbone flooring, while the statement kitchen island and premium integrated appliances create a striking focal point for cooking and socialising alike. Three beautifully finished bathrooms complete the offering, each a private sanctuary of refined materials and contemporary design.  Residents benefit from an outstanding four floors of dedicated amenities, including The Wellness Deck with fitness suite and climbing wall, The Green & Screen with putting green and outdoor cinema, Urban Tails dog spa, and The Flume Lounge & Kitchen — alongside 1.6 acres of landscaped riverside parkland set within the historic Castlefield Conservation Area.   Location   Neighbouring is St John's Culture & Enterprise Quarter, a flagship innovation district, a £1bn ecosystem driving over 10,100 new jobs in tech, media and creative enterprise. With more than 560,000 sq.ft of workspace and a 3,000 strong digital workforce already in place, it's at the forefront of the city's future economy.   Within 0.8 miles is Spinningfields, Manchester's central business district and world class hub & leisure district that has been a cornerstone to the city's success, supporting over 20,000 employee's across legal, finance and professional services across 4.5 million sq.ft of premium mixed use development that contributes over £1 billion annually to Manchester's economy.  The District is also home to globally renowned restaurants such as The Ivy, Sexy Fish and Tattu.  Manchester continues to shine for its excellence in education, with five universities attracting 116,000 new students per annum and a graduate retention rate of 51%, second to only London. listings.description: This striking three-bedroom duplex penthouse is set high above Birmingham in The Lancaster at Snow Hill Wharf, offering more than 1,600 square feet of beautifully designed living space. Arranged over the top two floors, it combines dramatic architecture, with vaulted ceilings reaching over five metres, and contemporary finishes throughout. Available either furnished or unfurnished, it provides a rare opportunity to enjoy both style and flexibility, with the added benefit of secure parking for three cars.   External and Communal Areas The Lancaster forms part of the award-winning Snow Hill Wharf development, positioned along the Birmingham and Fazeley Canal. The setting is both vibrant and peaceful, with landscaped podium gardens for residents to enjoy, while the city unfolds just beyond. On-site facilities are first-class, including a 24-hour concierge, private gym and wellness suite, cinema room, business spaces and resident lounges, creating a lifestyle that feels both exclusive and convenient.   Ground Floor (Lower Level) The lower floor is home to the three bedrooms, each designed with fitted storage and its own en-suite bathroom. The main bedroom has a sense of calm luxury, with extensive wardrobes and a bathroom that includes both a bathtub and a generous walk-in shower. The second bedroom is equally well appointed, with bespoke storage and a sleek shower room. The third bedroom, currently arranged as a nursery, benefits from dual-aspect windows, fitted wardrobes and its own private shower room. Practical touches, including additional storage and a separate cupboard housing the washer and dryer, are also found on this level.   First Floor (Upper Level) The upper floor is an expansive, light-filled space where living, dining and kitchen areas flow together beneath soaring ceilings and full-height windows. The kitchen, with its stone worktops, integrated appliances and central island, is designed for both entertaining and everyday life. The adjoining living and dining spaces open up beautifully to the views beyond, creating an atmosphere that is both impressive and welcoming. A guest cloakroom is also located on this level.   Parking Unusually for a city-centre home, the property includes secure underground parking for three vehicles, arranged as a single bay and a tandem space for two further cars.   Location Snow Hill Wharf occupies a prime position in Birmingham's city core. Snow Hill and New Street stations are both within walking distance, Colmore Row and the business district are close by, and the city's finest restaurants, bars and retail destinations are all just moments away. The upcoming HS2 station at Curzon Street will only strengthen the excellent transport connections, while the waterside setting offers a rare sense of calm in the middle of the city.   Tenure We have been advised that this property is leasehold, however, prospective buyers are advised to verify the position with their solicitor / legal representative.   Length of lease - 244 years. Service Charge: £9,000 per annual Ground Rent: £765 per annual.   Anti Money Laundering In accordance with the most recent Anti Money Laundering Legislation, buyers will be required to provide proof of identity and address to Rock Innovate Limited once an offer has been submitted and accepted (subject to contract) prior to Solicitors being instructed.
